Venetian Blinds in Abu Dhabi

Looking for venetian blinds in Abu Dhabi? K2 Curtains and Trading has over 16 years of experience fitting custom curtains, blinds, and home décor across the emirate. We bring fabric samples to your home, measure every window precisely, and install everything for a flawless finish.

Typical project range: AED 400 - AED 7,000

Our Venetian Blinds Process

Every project follows a clear, proven process so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

1

Window Survey

We measure width, drop, and recess depth, then advise on slat width (25mm or 50mm), material choice, and colour to complement your interior.

2

Material & Colour Selection

Choose from real wood, faux wood, or aluminium slats in dozens of finishes. We match samples to your flooring, furniture, and wall colours.

3

Made-to-Order Build

Each blind is built with precision-cut slats, durable ladder cords, a smooth tilt wand or cord mechanism, and a matching headrail.

4

Expert Fitting

We install brackets, hang the blind, level the slats, and demonstrate tilt and raise/lower controls for effortless daily use.

Frequently Asked Questions About Venetian Blinds

Do you offer free home measurement in Abu Dhabi?
Yes, we offer completely free home consultation and measurement throughout Abu Dhabi and surrounding areas. Our consultant brings fabric samples, measures your windows precisely, and provides a detailed quote with no obligation. Call +971 55 225 5639 to book your appointment.
How long does it take to make custom curtains?
Most custom curtain orders are ready within 7–14 days depending on fabric availability and complexity. For urgent requests, we offer an express service. Contact K2 Curtains and Trading on +971 55 225 5639 and we will confirm your timeline before you place the order.
What types of blinds do you supply in Abu Dhabi?
We supply and install Roman blinds, roller blinds, Venetian blinds, and motorized smart blinds across Abu Dhabi. Each blind is made to your exact window size with a choice of blackout, sunscreen, or translucent fabrics. Book a free consultation to see samples in your own home.
Can you install motorized curtains?
Absolutely. Our motorized curtain tracks integrate with Alexa, Google Home, and most smart home systems. We install silent motors, set up remote and voice control, and program schedules to suit your lifestyle. Call +971 55 225 5639 for a smart home curtain consultation.
Do you provide sofa upholstery services in Abu Dhabi?
Yes, we offer professional sofa reupholstery in Abu Dhabi. We strip old fabric, repair frames and foam, and recover your sofa in velvet, leather, linen, or performance fabric of your choice. We can also reupholster dining chairs, headboards, and Arabic majlis seating.
